questions.question: Akshar and Manvita recently celebrated their silver wedding anniversary and their older son Sanju’s birthday. If the age of Sanju 18 years after his parent’s marriage, and his age at their golden anniversary is in the ratio 5 ∶ 21, how many years after their marriage was Sanju born?
questions.questionHtml: Akshar and Manvita recently celebrated their silver wedding anniversary and their older son Sanju’s birthday. If the age of Sanju 18 years after his parent’s marriage, and his age at their golden anniversary is in the ratio 5 ∶ 21, how many years after their marriage was Sanju born?
questions.solution:
Let the age of Sanju at their silver anniversary = x years

18 years of marriage = 7 years before silver anniversary.

Sanju's age 7 years before silver anniversary = x - 7

Sanju's age 25 years after silver anniversary (golden anniversary) = x + 25

Note:- Silver anniversary = 25 years and golden anniversary = 50 years.

(x - 7)/(x + 25) = 5/21

Cross multiplying both sides,

21x - 147 = 5x + 125

16x = 272

x = 17 years.

Sanju's age on silver anniversary = 17 years

Sanju is born 25 - 17 years = 8 years after the marriage.

Hence, "option 1" is the correct answer.

The family tree is given below:-She is the daughter of my father's mother's only daughter's elder daughter.

Sripad's Paternal Grandmother's only daughter's = Sripad's paternal Aunt.

Sripad's paternal Aunt's elder daughter = Sripad's cousin sister daughter.

Sripad's cousin sister's daughter(Baby Girl) = Sripad's neice.

So, The mother of Baby Girl is Cousin of Sripad.

questions.solution: Magnesium is known as an alkaline earth metal. questions.question: ______ is an economic scenario where a peculiar combination of low growth and rising inflation leads to high unemployment.
questions.questionHtml: ______ is an economic scenario where a peculiar combination of low growth and rising inflation leads to high unemployment.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Stagflation.

  • Stagflation is an economic scenario where a particular combination of low growth and rising inflation leads to high unemployment.

Key Points

  • Stagflation:
    • The term was coined by lain Macleod, a Conservative Party MP in the United Kingdom, in November 1965.

questions.question: ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral such that when sides AB and DC are produced, they meet at E, and sides AD and BC meet at F, when produced. If ∠ADE = 80° and ∠AED = 50°, then what is the measure of ∠AFB?
questions.questionHtml: ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral such that when sides AB and DC are produced, they meet at E, and sides AD and BC meet at F, when produced. If ∠ADE = 80° and ∠AED = 50°, then what is the measure of ∠AFB?
questions.solution:
Given:

∠ADE = 80° 

∠AED = 50° 

Concept used:

In a cyclic quadrilateral, the sum of opposite angles are 180° 

Sum of linear pair of angles of is always 180° 

Sum of all 3 interior angles of triangle is 180° 

Calculation:

   

∠ADE + ∠ABC = 180° 

⇒ 80° + ∠ABC = 180° 

⇒ ∠ABC = (180° – 80°)

⇒ ∠ABC = 100° 

∠ABC + ∠CBE = 180° [straight line]

⇒ 100° + ∠CBE = 180° 

⇒ ∠CBE = (180° – 100°)

⇒ ∠CBE = 80° 

In ΔAED

⇒ ∠AED + ∠CBE + ∠ECB = 180° 

⇒ 50° + 80° + ∠ECB = 180° 

⇒ 130° + ∠ECB = 180° 

⇒ ∠ECB = (180° – 130°)

⇒ ∠ECB = 50° 

 Now,

⇒ ∠ECB = ∠DCF = 50° (Vertically opposite angles)

and 

∠FDC = 180° - ∠ADC (Linear pair)

∠FDC = 180° - 80° = 100°

∠FDC + ∠DCF + ∠AFB = 180° 

⇒ 100° + 50° +  ∠AFB = 180° 

⇒ 150° +  ∠AFB = 180° 

⇒ ∠AFB = (180° – 150°)

⇒ ∠AFB = 30° 

∴ The required value of ∠AFB is 30° 

Alternate Method 

From the above diagram,

⇒ ∠ADC + ∠CDF = 180°       [ Linear pair of angles]

⇒ 80° + ∠CDF = 180° 

⇒  ∠CDF = 100° 

Now, In  ΔAED

⇒ ∠AED + ∠ADE + ∠EAD = 180° 

⇒ 50° + 80° + ∠EAD = 180° 

⇒ ∠EAD = 180° - 130° = 50° 

Now, ∠EAD = ∠DCF = 50° 

In ΔDCF

⇒ ∠CDF + ∠DFC + ∠DCF = 180° 

⇒ 100° + ∠DFC + 50° = 180° 

⇒ ∠DFC = 180° - 150° = 30° 

⇒ ∠DFC = ∠AFB = 30° 

∴ The required value of ∠AFB is 30°

questions.question: A train covers 450 km at a uniform speed. If the speed had been 5 km/h more, it would have taken 1 hour less to cover the same distance. How much time will it take to cover 315 km at its usual speed?
questions.questionHtml: A train covers 450 km at a uniform speed. If the speed had been 5 km/h more, it would have taken 1 hour less to cover the same distance. How much time will it take to cover 315 km at its usual speed?
questions.solution:
Alternate MethodLet the actual speed be x km/h and the actual time taken be t hr.

Distance = (X × Y)/(X - Y) × [Time Difference]

⇒ 450 = {x × (x + 5)}/(x + 5 - x) × [t + 1 - t]

⇒ 450 = [x(x + 5)]/5

⇒ 2250 = x × (x + 5)

⇒ 2250 = 45 × (45 + 5)

On comparing x = 45 km/h

Actual time taken = 315/45 = 7 hr

Traditional method:

Given:

If the speed had been 5 km/h more, the train covered a distance = 450 km

If speed had been 1 hour less, the train covered a same distance

Formula used:

Speed = Distance/Time

Calculation:

Let the speed of train be x km

According to the question

⇒ 450/x – 450/x + 5 = 1

⇒ 450(x + 5) – 450x = x2 + 5x

⇒ 450x + 2250 – 450x = x2 + 5x

⇒ x2 + 5x – 2250 = 0

⇒ x2 + 50x – 45x - 2250 = 0

⇒ x(x + 50) – 45(x + 50) = 0

⇒ (x – 45)(x + 50) = 0

⇒ x = – 50, 45

⇒ x = 45 km/h

Now,

Time taken to cover the distance of 315 km = (315/45)

⇒ 7 h

∴ The required time is 7 h

Key Points

  • The given sentence is in Active Voice. As per the given question we have to change it into Passive Voice. 
  • The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
    • Subject + V2+ Object. (Active Voice)
    • Subject (objective case)+ was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
  • Example:
    • Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)
    • They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)
  • The subject of the given sentence is 'Richard'.​​
  • The object of the given sentence is 'A broad belt with shiny buckles'. 
  • The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
  • And 'wore' will be changed into 'was worn'. 
  • Lastly, the preposition  'by' will be added. 
  • Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 4.
    ​

Correct Sentence: A broad belt with shiny buckles was worn by Richard.

Hinglish 

  • ​दिया गया वाक्य Active Voice में है। दिए गए प्रश्न के अनुसार हमें इसे Passive Voice में बदलना है।
  • दिए गए वाक्य की संरचना इस प्रकार है:
    • Subject + V2+ Object. (Active Voice)

  • उदाहरण:
    • Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)

  • Object के स्थान पर Subject रखा जाएगा और Subject के स्थान पर Object रखा जाएगा।
  • 'wore' को 'was worn' में बदल दिया जाएगा।
  • अंत में, 'by' preposition जोड़ा जाएगा।
  • इसलिए, ऊपर वर्णित बिंदुओं के अनुसार, हम पाते हैं कि सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 है।

questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. It is also a rich source of news updates around the world.

B. Older people and children remain glued to it.

C. It has become a great source of entertainment for all.

D. TV has become a powerful medium these days.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'DBCA'.

Key Points

  • The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
  • We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'. 
  • Sentence D will be the first sentence because it is an independent general statement. It is talking about how powerful a medium TV has become these days.
  • Sentence B will be the next sentence because it further explains Sentence D. It tells us that older people and children watch TV all the time.
  • Sentence C will be the next sentence because older people and children watch TV a lot, hence, it is a great source of entertainment for them and others.
  • At last, sentence A will be used.
  • Thus, the correct sequence is:-
    • D: TV has become a powerful medium these days.
    • B: Older people and children remain glued to it.
    • C: It has become a great source of entertainment for all.
    • A: It is also a rich source of news updates around the world.

Correct Sequence: TV has become a powerful medium these days. Older people and children remain glued to it. It has become a great source of entertainment for all. It is also a rich source of news updates around the world.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'is much best than.'
Key Points

  • The error lies in part 'is much best than' of the sentence.
  • Comparative adjectives are used to compare differences between the two objects they modify (larger, smaller, faster, higher).
  • They are used in sentences where two nouns are compared, in this pattern:
    • Noun (subject) + verb + much + comparative adjective + than + noun (object).
      • Example: The rock flew much higher than the roof.
  • Therefore, the use of 'much best than' in the sentence should be replaced by 'much better than' to make it grammatically correct.
  • Therefore, the correct answer is 'is much best than.'
  • ​Correct sentence: The food in the new eatery is much better than the one in RK Puram.

 Additional Information 

  • When two items/people are compared, a comparative degree is used by putting ‘er’ to the adjective word in association with the word ‘than’.
  • In some cases ‘more’ is used.
    • Example: She is smarter than her sister.
                       She is more cheerful than her sister.

 Hinglish

questions.question: Direction: The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them contains an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. The Committee agreed / that small businesses / has been adversely affected / by COVID19.

The Committee agreed / that small businesses / has been adversely affected / by COVID19.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'has been adversely affected.'

Key Points

  • The error lies in Part (has been adversely affected) of the sentence.
  • The noun businesses is a plural noun.
  • According to subject-verb agreement, it must take a plural verb.
  • ​Therefore, the use of 'has been adversely affected' in the sentence should be replaced with 'have been adversely affected' to make it grammatically correct.
  • Therefore, the correct answer is 'has been adversely affected.'
  • ​Correct sentence: The Committee agreed that small businesses have been adversely affected by COVID19.

 Additional Information 
 
 
 

  • We can use not … ever instead of never, but never is much more common.
    • Example: She has never been a friend of ours.

Hinglish  
 

  • त्रुटि वाक्य के Part (has been adversely affected) में निहित है।
  • Noun businesses, plural संज्ञा है।
  • Subject-verb agreement के अनुसार, इसे plural verb अवश्य लेनी चाहिए।
  • इसलिए, वाक्य के 'has been adversely affected' का उपयोग 'have been adversely affected' के साथ प्रतिस्थापित किया जाना चाहिए, इसे व्याकरणिक रूप से सही बनाने के लिए।

questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'lowest.'
Key Points

  • We use a superlative to say that a thing or person is the most of a group.
  • When we use a superlative adjective ('the tallest student') before the noun, we generally use it with 'the'.
  • This is because there's only one (or one group) of the thing we are talking about.
    • Example: This bowl is the biggest one.
  • Therefore, the correct answer is 'lowest.'
  • ​Correct sentence: The lack of regular academic sessions has meant that in 2020 the country has had the lowest share of students who have attended educational institutions. 

 Additional Information 

  • When two items/people are compared, a comparative degree is used by putting ‘er’ to the adjective word in association with the word ‘than’.
  • In some cases ‘more’ is used.
    • Example: She is smarter than her sister.
                       She is more cheerful than her sister.

Hinglish 
 

  • हम यह कहने के लिए superlative  का उपयोग करते हैं कि कोई वस्तु या व्यक्ति समूह में सबसे अधिक है।
  • जब हम संज्ञा से पहले एक superlative adjective ('the tallest student') का उपयोग करते हैं, तो हम आम तौर पर इसे 'the' के साथ प्रयोग करते हैं।
  • ऐसा इसलिए है क्योंकि हम जिस चीज के बारे में बात कर रहे हैं उसका केवल एक (या एक समूह) है।
    • Example: This bowl is the biggest one.
  • इसलिए, सही उत्तर 'lowest' है।​
